# Game reference

[Documentation](../README.md) › Game reference

The types, functions and probes of Cube World Alpha v0.1.1 that Kyubu has mapped, generated from the mapping database (`mapping/` in the Kyubu source) by `kmap export`. Only entries at `verified` or `candidate` status are listed:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| verified | confirmed; loader features may rely on it |
| candidate | probably right, but not confirmed yet |

Function and global names are what `resolve_symbol`, `kyubu.symbol` and the hooks take (see [hooks.md](../hooks.md)); addresses are at the preferred image base 0x400000. The C types are in `sdk/include/cubeworld/` and the Lua types in `require("cubeworld")` (see [lua.md](../lua.md)).
